FarmMind (formerly FarmSmarter.ai) – Smarter Decisions, Smarter Fields

Transform the way you farm with FarmMind, the all-in-one AI platform designed for modern growers, consultants, and ag professionals. Powered by agentic AI, GIS mapping, and real-time agronomic intelligence, FarmMind gives you the insights you need—faster, smarter, and always compliant.

From AI chat advisors to precision soil and field management, FarmMind helps you save time, cut costs, and boost yields—all in one sleek, easy-to-use app.



Key Features
Chat Mode – Your AI Agronomist

Ask anything—get regulation-compliant answers powered by 16k+ EPA-approved labels, AgCenter data, and state rules.
Choose models for your needs: Standard, Pesticide AI, SoilSense AI, or GeoSense AI.
Upload documents, reference your fields, and get tailored recommendations instantly.
Export chats, switch between histories, and keep your work organized.



GIS Mapping – Smarter Fields at Your Fingertips

Draw, upload, or auto-generate field boundaries with shapefiles/geojson.
Add crops, planting dates, varieties, soil types, irrigation methods & more.
Filter, tag, batch-update, and color-code your fields.
Export interactive maps with notes, overlays, and soil grids as shareable PDFs.



Documentation – Farming records made easy

Create, customize, and template field notes for quick data capture.
Create recommendations right in the app.
Import from PDF, Excel, images, or text—FarmMind’s AI auto-converts them.
Export anything instantly, or share with your organization.



Data Visualization – See Your Fields Like Never Before

Turn any dataset into dynamic time graphs, heat maps, and spatial models.
Overlay with NDVI, elevation, soil composition, and weather data.
Generate Variable Rate Fertilization Applications across zones to optimize inputs.


Species Identification – AI in Your Pocket


Snap a photo of any plant, insect, or fungus.
Get the top 5 species predictions with detailed info.
Add IDs to notes or analyze them further in chat.
Download models for offline scouting in low-connectivity areas.



Dashboards – Your Farm’s Command Center

Build custom dashboards to track ROI, margins, costs, yields, and more.
Compare across fields, seasons, or varieties.
View growth timelines, GDU tracking, rain events, weather analysis, and soil insights.

Weather & Irrigation – Instant insights

See weather for multiple fields at a time.
Analyze accumulated precipitation for up to a year in the past.
Record your irrigation events and systems.



Why FarmMind?

Smarter Decisions: Regulation-compliant AI at your service.
Efficiency Boost: Save hours with instant maps, notes, and recommendations.
All-in-One Platform: AI + GIS + Scouting + Economics + Dashboards.
For Modern Growers: Designed to put the power of precision ag & AI right in your hands.

Farm smarter. Grow better. Stay ahead.
Download FarmMind today and put the future of farming in your pocket.

record.name: RiverFox - Irrigation Planning
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Higher yields - and save water, effort and costs!


Summers are getting drier - irrigation is now an integral part of securing yields. Actively counteract drought stress.
With RiverFox, you receive clear, yield-maximizing irrigation recommendations - individually for each field and taking into account the crop type and sowing time. 



Mobile monitoring of your fields on your smartphone and desktop: Never forget to irrigate a field or shut a pipe again!


With RiverFox you always have an overview of your fields. Get new soil moisture information daily by analyzing satellite images and weather stations. If a critical value is under- or exceeded, a warning appears directly on your cell phone.



Precise cost analysis and automatic documentation of irrigation for your quality assurance!

With RiverFox you can digitally coordinate all irrigation measures and have your irrigation documented for quality assurance. The record-keeping allows you to accurately analyze your irrigation costs at the end of the season.


Optimize irrigation timing to better coordinate peak workloads!

Coordinate your employees, take into account crop protection measures such as fertilizer service, your seed calendar and distribute tasks digitally. The RiverFox irrigation app shows you which fields need irrigation, helping you prioritize, allocate tasks and grow vegetables. RiverFox is intuitively designed so even foremen in the field can make the right decisions.


Use your water rights wisely at the right time! 

The agriculture industry is experiencing more and more restrictions on irrigation. With RiverFox, you can irrigate more efficiently and save water rights. This way you avoid crop damage. The saved water rights can be carried over to the next year. RiverFox users can irrigate and harvest on all fields even in dry years - and enjoy high yields on all fields.


With RiverFox, you get mobile soil moisture and agricultural weather information for your crops. The analysis of satellite images with the possibility to connect your own weather station achieves field-accurate irrigation suggestions. With the Geisenheim model, market gardeners receive irrigation forecasts individually for their crop (from corn to potatoes to cut lettuce) and can thus optimize their cultivation. The artificial intelligence behind the analyses of satellite images and weather data works very accurately. Moisture measurements are now possible for the first time without additional equipment and associated maintenance. This is a decisive cost and effort advantage over conventional methods of soil moisture measurement. Rainfall forecasts are taken into account with field accuracy for the first time, increasing the reliability of recommendations. Desiccation warnings help prevent plant damage. 


RiverFox - grow with every drop
 
RiverFox is a smart farming system from heliopas.ai GmbH.

record.name: MrAg - Farm AI Advisor
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
MrAg is an AI-powered farm advisor built for Midwest row crop farmers. It combines real-time weather data, field-level intelligence, and AI analysis to help you make better decisions every day of the growing season.

DECISION WINDOWS
MrAg analyzes weather forecasts, soil conditions, and your crop's growth stage to identify the best windows for planting, spraying, sidedressing, tillage, and harvest. Each window includes an AI confidence score, risk factors, and plain-language reasoning — so you know why, not just when.

SCOUT & DIAGNOSE
Take a photo of a crop issue in the field and get an AI-powered diagnosis in seconds. MrAg identifies diseases, pests, and weeds, explains what it sees, rates severity and confidence, and gives you actionable treatment recommendations. Follow-up reminders keep you on track.

ASK MRAG
Chat with an AI advisor that knows your farm. MrAg has context on your fields, crops, growth stages, weather, grain inventory, costs, and scout history — so every answer is tailored to your operation, not generic advice.

GRAIN MARKETING
Track stored grain inventory, log sales by contract type, and monitor break-even prices. The What-If Calculator lets you model different price and yield scenarios against your actual cost of production.

FIELD RECORDS
Manage fields, track seasons, log growth stages, and record yields. View yield history across years and fields. Start new seasons with one tap using smart crop rotation defaults.

WEATHER
Field-level forecasts from the National Weather Service with hourly and daily views. Frost risk alerts and precipitation tracking help you plan around the weather instead of reacting to it.

BUILT FOR THE MIDWEST
MrAg is designed for corn and soybean farmers in Iowa, Illinois, Indiana, Minnesota, Wisconsin, Nebraska, and surrounding states. Every AI prompt, cost default, and recommendation is tuned for Midwest row crop operations.

SUBSCRIPTION TIERS
• Free: Limited access to Scout, Advisor, and Decision Windows
• A 7-day free trial is available for new subscribers to MrAg Pro. If you don't cancel before the trial ends, your subscription will automatically convert to a paid subscription at the standard rate.
• MrAg Pro (Auto-Renewable Subscription): $19.99/month or $179.99/year. Enhanced access to Scout, Advisor, and Decision Windows. PDF season reports and CSV data export available.
• MrAg Elite (Auto-Renewable Subscription): $59.99/month or $539.99/year. Everything in Pro with higher usage limits for large operations.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your App Store account settings.

Your data is stored locally on your device. MrAg never shares your farm data with third parties.

Terms of Use: https://mrag.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://mrag.app/privacy

Stop guessing what to ask AI. Start getting results you can actually use.

AI Ready is an interactive journey designed to turn everyday AI use from trial and error into a practical skill.

Instead of sitting through lessons or memorizing prompt formulas, you learn by doing.

Make choices. Improve instructions. Compare results. Spot mistakes. Build better prompts. Unlock practical tools you can use again outside the app.

LEARN THROUGH INTERACTIVE QUESTS

Progress through 10 quests that take you from AI fundamentals to confident, advanced use:

• Stop Using AI Like Google
• Improve What You Already Have
• Create From Rough Thoughts
• Prepare for Real-Life Situations
• Turn Ideas Into Plans
• Use AI as a Daily Project Partner
• Discover Practical AI Life Hacks
• Learn AI's Failure Modes
• Build With AI Without Being Technical
• Build Your AI Operating System

LEARN BY DOING

AI Ready isn't built around long lectures.

Missions put you inside practical situations where you:

• Choose between weak and strong approaches
• Build and improve instructions
• See how small changes transform AI output
• Diagnose common AI mistakes
• Practice real-world situations
• Discover techniques you can use immediately

SEE WHY BETTER PROMPTS WORK

Don't just copy prompts.

Learn how context, objectives, requirements, expectations, tone, structure, and iteration change the result — so you can adapt what you learn to almost any AI tool or situation.

UNLOCK POWER CARDS

As you progress, unlock reusable Power Cards designed for real situations.

Use them when you need help preparing a conversation, improving writing, creating a plan, checking an AI answer, continuing a project, and much more.

GO BEYOND BASIC PROMPTING

AI Ready progresses from everyday AI use into more advanced capabilities, including:

• Working with AI across longer projects
• Using screenshots and visual information
• Recognizing hallucinations and confidence errors
• Checking and improving AI answers
• Using AI as a planning and thinking partner
• Building with AI without being a developer
• Creating your own repeatable AI workflows

USE WHAT YOU LEARN WITH THE AI TOOLS YOU ALREADY HAVE

The principles taught in AI Ready are designed to transfer across modern AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude.

AI Ready does not provide those services itself and is not affiliated with their respective providers.

Discover. Learn. Explore. Grow.

AVNI is an AI-powered plant and crop identification app designed for school students and young explorers. Developed by Annam.AI, Centre of Excellence in Digital Agriculture at IIT Ropar, with the support of the Ministry of Education, Government of India, AVNI makes learning about plants, crops, and nature fun, interactive, and engaging.

DISCOVER PLANTS WITH AI

Simply point your camera at a plant leaf or crop, and AVNI uses AI-powered image recognition to identify it. Explore more than 107 crop and plant classes found across Indian agriculture and discover useful information about each one.

KEY FEATURES

- AI Plant Scanner: Identify plants and crops using your camera and view an AI confidence score.

- Plant and Crop Classes: Explore cereals, millets, pulses, oilseeds, vegetables, fruits, spices, commercial crops, fodder, and ornamental plants.

- Rich Plant Profiles: Learn about uses, growing regions, care tips, scientific classification, and interesting facts.

- Audio Narration: Listen to plant information in English and Hindi.

- Daily Challenges: Complete missions, discover new plants, and earn reward points.

- Nature Gallery: Explore plants and crops through organized categories and imagery.

- Gamification: Earn Nature Points, unlock avatars, and track your discovery journey.

- Bilingual Learning: Enjoy the experience in English and Hindi.

MADE FOR YOUNG EXPLORERS

AVNI is designed especially for school students from Classes 3 to 8. It turns nature walks, school activities, and outdoor exploration into exciting learning adventures.

Teachers can also use AVNI as a learning tool for environmental science, agriculture, and nature education.

OUR MISSION

India has a rich and diverse agricultural heritage. AVNI aims to help the next generation discover and understand this heritage through AI-powered, accessible, and enjoyable learning.

When children learn about the plants growing around them, they build a deeper connection with nature, agriculture, and farming.

Annam.AI is the Centre of Excellence in Digital Agriculture at IIT Ropar, supported by the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Our mission is to use artificial intelligence and technology to transform Indian agriculture through education, research, and accessible digital solutions.

Child safety and privacy are important to us. AVNI is designed to work with minimal permissions and requires camera access for plant scanning. Please review our privacy policy to learn how account and scan information is processed.

Download AVNI and start your journey to grow with nature!

What should you grow on this field, and what will it earn you? Cerere looks at your soil, your climate, your water and your costs, and ranks the crops that suit your land, field by field.

START BY TALKING
Tell Cerere where your land is and what grows on it, by typing or by voice. She asks a few questions, you draw your field on the map, and you see what fits. No forms, no technical knowledge needed.

WHAT YOU GET
• Your fields on the map, each with its soil and its climate
• A ranking of crops for every field, with a Botana Score from 0 to 100 across soil, climate, water, profit and risk
• Costs, revenue and estimated profit per crop, and you can replace any price or cost with your own
• Weather alerts for the field that is actually hit, with what to do about it
• Olive, citrus, almond, pistachio, carob, avocado and more: the young years of a new orchard are counted, not hidden
• Photograph a sick leaf and ask Cerere what it could be
• Photograph your soil analysis and the app reads it for you

WHAT IT IS BUILT ON
• More than 300 crops and varieties, including Sicilian durum landraces such as Russello, Timilia and Perciasacchi
• Thirty years of daily weather at your field's own coordinates, a seven-day forecast and a seasonal outlook
• World soil maps at your exact point. Your own lab analysis always replaces the estimate
• Water needs calculated month by month with the FAO method

AN AGRONOMIST BEHIND THE APP
Cerere works with your agronomist, never instead of them.

GETTING STARTED
Create your account and see your own fields, your weather alerts and a preview of what suits your land.

Stored in Europe. Cerere's AI runs in Switzerland. We never sell your data, and you can export or delete it whenever you want.

Vegetable Identifier is a smart AI-powered app that helps you identify vegetables instantly and effortlessly. Just snap a photo or upload an image of any vegetable, and the Vegetable Identifier app uses advanced machine learning to recognize and match it with a wide variety of known produce.

Whether you’re a home cook, gardener, student, or just curious, Vegetable Identifier gives you fast, accurate identification along with detailed insights—such as nutritional value, culinary uses, seasonality, storage tips, health benefits, and more. With the Vegetable Identifier app, you can even chat with AI to ask specific vegetable-related questions and save your favorite vegetables to revisit later.

Perfect for foodies, market explorers, farmers, or anyone passionate about healthy eating, Vegetable Identifier makes learning about your food easy, fun, and informative. It’s the ultimate companion for discovering and understanding vegetables from around the world.

Free users can identify one vegetable and ask up to two AI questions — unlimited access requires a subscription. Unlock the full potential of Vegetable Identifier and explore the produce aisle like never before.

Teralab: AI Soil Analyzer

Teralab is a specialized soil analyzer that transforms your mobile device into a professional tool for land assessment. By leveraging Advanced AI Vision and connectivity to global soil lab databases, Teralab provides a detailed view of your terrain’s condition without the need for a physical soil probe.

AI-Powered Soil Analysis: Obtain an immediate assessment of your ground's quality. Our new Gemini-powered engine cross-validates visual evidence with real-time environmental data for professional accuracy.

Pedology & Agrobiology: Explore the biological and physical composition of your land, including pH estimates, salinity levels, and organic matter detection.

Soil Moisture Monitor: Track hydration levels using visual AI data and external soil indicators for precise water balance and irrigation planning.

Health & Monitor Tools: Detect erosion risks, compaction, and essential soil health markers (SSI) to prevent land degradation.

Instant Soil Photo Analysis: Simply take a soil pic to receive a structured data report in seconds—from texture classification to nutrient mobility.

Comprehensive Soil Lab Access: Professional-grade soil analyze capabilities for agriculture, research, and precision farming at your fingertips.

Data-Driven Insights: Make informed planting and management decisions based on real-time soil data and AI-generated expert agronomic advice.

record.description_evidence:
Discover which breed your cattle are with Cow Breed Identifier. Point your camera at a cow or upload a photo, and our AI analyzes it to suggest the most likely cattle breeds.

Whether you're a farmer, a rancher, a student, or just curious about cattle, Cow Breed Identifier is a handy tool for learning about the cows you see around you.

Key features
• Identify cattle breeds from photos
• View ranked breed matches with AI confidence scores
• Browse breed details, including origin, use, and characteristics
• Access scan history of previous identifications
• Use camera tools such as crosshairs and flash for better capture

Subscription required for premium features:
